author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Side-view walker read at 48px and 384px in light and dark: tray, post, hanging seat, a rightward arm reaching the right edge, a box body under it and a flat bottom base, as in the reference.
omissions: Wheels (circular ends) removed per feedback; the reference's rounded-bar arm and base are drawn as single strokes with round caps; seat is a U hung from the tray rather than a J.
lucide_reference: No useful Lucide match; plain line/box construction.
feedback: Recreate the rightward arm and bottom base, remove the circular ends.
